BatteryLeadP.instruction: Thread before closing the fixed contact carriers; fit and trim the blank to the declared route/joint target. Bottom the stripped conductor in the selected0854 solder cup; keep the insulation outside the joint. No live plug. Cut/fit settings are unmeasured.

BatteryLeadN.cut_basis: One continuous negative lead: contact cup strip, fixed conduit segment, routed external segment and boost clamp strip; no tail strip or splice.
BatteryLeadN.instruction: One continuous conductor through the fixed negative conduit toBOOST.X2.1. Use the full loom cut; do not cut a separate contact tail or add a splice.
